claims.evidence: Photos show a Yamaha keyboard and logo, but no model number or professional-grade marking is visible.
Photos show keys and buttons but not their function.
No power adapter is visible in any photo.
No receipt, label, or marking showing UK origin is visible in the photos.
No key-by-key function test is shown.
No audio output test is shown.

risks.risk: Keyboard does not power on or produce sound.
risks.proof: Video of the keyboard powering on and playing through its speakers or headphones.

risks.risk: Keys are sticky, broken, yellowed, or dead.
risks.proof: Close-up video pressing every key to confirm action and sound.

risks.risk: Buttons or controls do not function.
risks.proof: Video demonstrating every button, slider, and display function.

risks.risk: Power adapter, stand, or manual are missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the adapter, stand, and manual together with the keyboard.
risks.if_unproven: as unit only with no accessories.

risks.risk: Hidden damage on the back, underside, or inside.
risks.proof: Photos of the back panel, underside, and any accessible interior.

risks.risk: Age and wear are unknown; UK origin unproven.
risks.proof: Purchase receipt or serial number and a photo of the power plug label.
risks.if_unproven: as used with unknown age and possible plug incompatibility.

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and playing sound.
Video pressing every key and testing every button.
Photo of the power adapter, stand, and manual if included.
Photos of the back, underside, and any labels including model and serial number.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Yamaha electronic keyboard, so it can be priced at its worst case; unproven function and missing accessories are risks that lower the price until proven.
